title: How Unimora is inspiring the next generation of aged care professionals through VR, built with Unity
summary: Unimora, built with Unity, lets students experience both sides of aged care in VR to inspire care careers. A Unity for Humanity 2026 Honourable Mention.
body_markdown:
## **Building an immersive experience with Unity**


Unity is at the center of how Mindflight7 builds Unimora and its wider library of[immersive learning experiences](https://unity.com/solutions/immersive-training) .


Mindflight7 works with external development partners to deliver more than ten new VR experiences to schools each year, an output it expects to roughly double as AI becomes more integrated into its workflow. It leads the learning and interaction design, while its technical lead works inside partner teams to turn those designs into production-ready applications.


For this distributed model, Unity is the team’s go-to VR platform. The size and maturity of the[Unity XR ecosystem](https://unity.com/solutions/xr) make it easier to bring new developers onto a project without introducing an unfamiliar stack. Its component-based architecture makes it simpler to divide work across interaction, UI, environments, visual effects, and gameplay systems. Rapid prototyping suits educational VR, which benefits from frequent testing and refinement rather than long development cycles.


In Unimora, Unity powers the full real-time experience: the first-person shifts between Joyce and Grace, hand-based interactions, environmental objects, character animation, UI prompts, and the branching decisions that shape each student’s final reflection.


The team also developed custom[shaders](https://unity.com/resources/create-shaders-visual-effects-urp-unity-6) , including effects that represent changes in Joyce’s eyesight, and a real-time mirror solution built to run within the performance constraints of standalone VR headsets. The mirror became a key storytelling device in the scene where Joyce sees her younger self and Arthur, and achieving it convincingly on that hardware meant carefully balancing visual quality against rendering performance.


AI-assisted development is another reason Mindflight7 is deepening its work with Unity. Developers on its projects have found Unity easy to integrate into[AI-enabled workflows](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aVhWVdjPq-g) . MCP-based integrations, and more recently[Unity CLI](https://unity.com/resources/a-beginners-guide-to-unity-cli-and-the-pipeline-package) workflows, give AI systems more direct access to a project’s structure and state, shortening the cycle between idea, implementation, testing, and revision.
